name: 陳世剛
objective:
各種時域響應之電腦繪圖，矩陣各項特性分析與應用，根值軌跡圖，波德圖，奈奎士圖，PID 控制器之設計，Lead-Lag 補償器之設計，控制器時域及頻域分析，控制器在狀態空間之設計，實例探討，書報研讀。
Course Title:Automatic Control Practice
Description:This course is first to introduce the basic concepts of
control systems and the mathematical background, second, state the
transfer function, block diagram and signal flow graph, third,
discuss the mathematical modeling of control systems and elements, and
forth, describe the time-domain analysis, root locus techniques and
frequency-domain of control systems, and then to measure the character
of control systems, Finally, the design of control system will be
introduced.
schedule:
Week 1: Course Overview and Introduction
Week 2: Introduction of MATLAB
Week 3: Introduction of Simulink
Week 4: Modeling in the Frequency Domain and Time Domain
Week 5: Time Responses Analysis and Steady-State Errors
Week 6: Root Locus Analysis
Week 7: PID Controller Design
Week 8: Frequency Response Analysis
Week 9: Frequency Response-Compensation
Week 10: Frequency Response-Nyquist Plot and Stability
Week 11: Converter Control Applications
Week 12: Converter Control Applications
Week 13: Open Loop Speed Control of Three Phase PMSM
Week 14: Closed Loop Speed Control of Three Phase PMSM
Week 15: Open Lab.
Week 16: Final Project
